note: All 45 checked. Composer spellings all match the violin catalogue; the five chamber-only composers (Hoffstetter, Rossini, Borodin, Puccini, Wolf) have correct dates and nationalities. Main fixes: Debussy quartet needs old Lesure L. 85; Janáček No. 2 needs JW VII/13 (as the violin catalogue does for Janáček); Wolf's Italian Serenade is in G major; Cypresses B. 152 gains the aka 'Echo of Songs'; the Terzetto note wrongly said 'written for amateurs'. Minor optional points: Grieg Op. 27 is often numbered 'String Quartet No. 1'; Puccini's Crisantemi has Schickling number SC 65.
